name: Jahoda
title: Windthreading Shadow
description: A legendary bounty hunter of Nod-Krai who currently works as a 'do-it-all' employee for the Curatorium of Secrets. She is lively, clever, and claims to be extremely reliable.

skillTalents.name: Strike While the Arrow's Hot
skillTalents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 consecutive shots with a bow.
Charged Attack
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG. While aiming, mighty winds will accumulate on the arrowhead. A fully charged wind arrow will deal Anemo DMG.
Plunging Attack
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, hitting opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skillTalents.name: Savvy Strategy: Splitting the Spoils
skillTalents.description:
Jahoda dashes toward her opponent, entering the Shadow Pursuit state upon contact. While in this state, Jahoda moves continuously and swiftly. If nearby opponents are affected by Pyro, Hydro, Electro, or Cryo, she will quietly convert her Purr-loined Treasure Flask to that element, gradually filling it. When the duration ends or the skill is used again, Jahoda drains the Flask and deals a single instance of Anemo DMG to nearby opponents. When the Flask is full, Jahoda immediately drains it, dealing a more powerful instance of Anemo DMG and exiting the state.
Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam
When the Purr-loined Treasure Flask becomes full, Jahoda will not immediately discharge it. Instead, for a short duration, she steadily consumes the stored element inside and periodically fires Fluffy Meowballs at nearby opponents, dealing DMG of the corresponding element. When a Fluffy Meowball hits an opponent, Jahoda regenerates 2 Elemental Energy (once every 3.5s).

skillTalents.name: Hidden Aces: Seven Tools of the Hunter
skillTalents.description: Jahoda retrieves 2 Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots and deals a single instance of Anemo DMG to nearby opponents. The robots will periodically deal Anemo DMG to nearby opponents and heal active party members based on Jahoda's ATK.

passiveTalents.name: Plan to Get Paid
passiveTalents.description:
The Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots are enhanced based on the element with the highest number of characters in the party:
- Pyro: Deals 130% of original DMG.
- Hydro: Heals for 120% of original healing amount.
- Electro: Number of Robots increases by 1.
- Cryo: Attack interval reduced by 10%.

passiveTalents.name: Sweet Berry Bounty
passiveTalents.description: When a Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robot heals an active team member, if that character's HP is above 70%, their Elemental Mastery is increased by 100 for 6s.

passiveTalents.name: Moonsign Benediction: Rooftop Dash
passiveTalents.description: When Jahoda is in the party, the party's Moonsign will increase by 1 level.

passiveTalents.name: Backstreet Guile
passiveTalents.description: When dispatched on an expedition in Nod-Krai, time consumed is reduced by 25%.

constellations.name: One More Flask!
constellations.description: When a Fluffy Meowball fired by the Elemental Skill hits an enemy, there is a 50% chance for it to bounce, dealing the corresponding Elemental DMG to nearby opponents.

constellations.name: Rogue's Quick Thinking
constellations.description: In the Ascension Talent 'Plan to Get Paid,' Jahoda can secretly track the element with the second highest number of characters in addition to the first, allowing up to two elemental effects to be active at once.

constellations.name: Desperate Gamble
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Hidden Aces: Seven Tools of the Hunter by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Wild Berry Amid the Dust
constellations.description: When a Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robot from the Elemental Burst undergoes an Elemental Conversion, Jahoda will recover 4 Elemental Energy.

constellations.name: The Greatest Treasure
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Savvy Strategy: Splitting the Spoils by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: The Littlest Luck
constellations.description: Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: After the Purr-loined Treasure Flask from the Elemental Skill is full, nearby Moonsign characters in your party have their CRIT Rate increased by 5% and CRIT DMG increased by 40% for 20s.
